- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover

- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release

Changes:
0: [sign_in, new_flow] Account Recovery and Reconnection Verification Flow: Introduces a guided multi-step account verification component on the sign-in screen to help returning users verify existing pet profiles before signing in. (why: 8 support emails cited pets missing or reset after signing in again, showing account recognition is a major friction point.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Photo Upload Stage with Live Pet Canvas Preview: Redesign the upload_photos screen into a stage layout featuring a real-time preview component beside photo upload options. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption has an 89s median completion time.)
2: [finish, redesign] Redesign Home Intro with Desktop Control Interactive Cards: Rebuild home_intro screen using a spotlight layout with interactive cards demonstrating hide, summon, and pet voice controls. (why: 3 support emails highlighted confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Save State Account Status Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen clarifying how logging in safeguards multi-device pet profile saves. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back into their accounts.)
4: [choose_path, new_flow] Story Screen Animated Companion Mascot Intro Flow: Transform the story screen into a story_scroll layout featuring an animated mascot welcome component. (why: Choose path drop-off begins right at the initial story screen, where user engagement can be significantly improved.)

scores.note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign_in drop-off, but multi-step new flow requires new screens and carries execution risk.
Adoption has highest drop-off (28.2%) with supporting emails, and adoption redesign previously averaged +2.5% across tests.
Finish stage has drop-off and support emails, but previous finish redesign test was negative (-1.3%).
High evidence from support emails and low implementation cost (hint text), but copy/hint changes on sign-in and other screens consistently underperform.
Lacks support email evidence, choose_path changes historically failed, and new_flow changes tend to reduce conversion.
